column1: # Stage S10 H1a, fourth of four: the rest of the frontend's transport (the HTTP client, the typed
# endpoint calls, the live server status and audit log streams, the server-sent event frame reader
# and the token provider seam) becomes crates/frontend/foundation/frontend_transport. The folder
# becomes the crate's `src`, its module tree `lib.rs`. The prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to the
# moved folder and one `frontend_transport::` row scoped to the app's source.
